1 : 0)};\n}\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Kept as separate multiply and add (no FMA contraction) to match the serial reference\n__attribute__((optimize(\"fp-contract=off\"))) void applyForces(Vec3* vel, const double* Fx, const double* Fy, const double* Fz, size_t len) {\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < len; ++k) {\n        vel[k].x += DT * Fx[k];\n        vel[k].y += DT * Fy[k];\n        vel[k].z += DT * Fz[k];\n    }\n}\n\n// Updates velocities of the local bodies [begin, begin + count) against all n bodies.\n// Each body's force accumulates over j = 0..n-1 in the same order as the serial loop,\n// so results are bit-identical for any number of ranks. The inner loop runs over the\n// local bodies, which vectorizes without reordering any floating-point sum.\nvoid computeForces(const Vec3* pos, size_t n, size_t begin, size_t count, Vec3* vel) {\n    std::vector<double> xi(count), yi(count), zi(count);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {\n        xi[i] = pos[begin + i].x;\n        yi[i] = pos[begin + i].y;\n        zi[i] = pos[begin + i].z;\n    }\n\n    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < count; tile += TILE) {\n        const size_t len = std::min(TILE, count - tile);\n        double Fx[TILE] = {}, Fy[TILE] = {}, Fz[TILE] = {};\n\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double xj = pos[j].x;\n            const double yj = pos[j].y;\n            const double zj = pos[j].z;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < len; ++k) {\n                const double dx = xj - xi[tile + k];\n                const double dy = yj - yi[tile + k];\n                const double dz = zj - zi[tile + k];\n                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n                Fx[k] += dx * invDist3;\n                Fy[k] += dy * invDist3;\n                Fz[k] += dz * invDist3;\n            }\n        }\n\n        applyForces(vel + tile, Fx, Fy, Fz, len);\n    }\n}\n\nvoid integrateBodies(Vec3* pos, const Vec3* vel, size_t count) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {\n        pos[i].x += vel[i].x * DT;\n        pos[i].y += vel[i].y * DT;\n        pos[i].z += vel[i].z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    double energy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x +\n                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y +\n                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numBodies =        return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return state; each keeps only its own block\n    std::vector<Body> bodies(n);\n    randomizeBodies(bodies);\n\n    const Range mine = blockRange(n, rank, size);\n    // Per-rank element counts and displacements in doubles (3 per body) for the collectives\n    std::vector<int> counts(size), displs(size);\n    for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        const Range range = blockRange(n, r, size);\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(3 * range.count);\n        displs[r] = static_cast<int>(3 * range.begin);\n    }\n\n    // Positions of all bodies are replicated on every rank; velocities are ++i) {\n        vel[i] = bodies[mine.begin + i].vel;\n    }\n    double* posData = reinterpret_cast<double*>(pos.data());\n\n    // Run simulation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = 1 : 0)};\n}\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Velocity update kept as a separate multiply and add. The inner loop runs over the\n// local bodies, which vectorizes without reordering any floating-point sum.\nvoid computeForces(const Vec3* pos, size_t n, size_t begin, size_t count, Vec3* vel) {\n i].z;\n    }\n\n    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < count; tile += TILE) {\n        const size_t len = std::min(TILE, count - tile);\n        double Fx[TILE] = {}, Fy[TILE] = {}, Fz[TILE] = {};\n\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double xj = pos[j].x;\n            const double yj = pos[j].y;\n            const double zj = pos[j].z;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < len; ++k) {\n                const double dx = xj - xi[tile + k];\n                const double dy = yj - yi[tile + k];\n                const double dz = zj - zi[tile + k];\n                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n                Fx[k] += dx * invDist3;\n                Fy[k] += dy * invDist3;\n                Fz[k] += dz * invDist3;\n            }\n        }\n\n        applyForces(vel + tile, Fx, Fy, Fz, len);\n    }\n}\n\nvoid integrateBodies(Vec3* pos, const Vec3* vel, size_t count) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {\n        pos[i].x += vel[i].x * DT;\n        pos[i].y += vel[i].y * DT;\n        pos[i].z += vel[i].z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    double energy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x +\n                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y +\n                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = displacements in doubles (3 per body) for the collectives\n    std::vector<int> counts(size), displs(size);\n    for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        const Range range = blockRange(n, r, size);\n ++i) {\n        vel[i] = bodies[mine.begin + i].vel;\n    }\n    double* posData = reinterpret_cast<double*>(pos.data());\n\n    // Run simulation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyNmHqnQm175BeZ8Hw31","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The benchmark is now MPI-parallel. It builds cleanly with no warnings, and its output matches the original serial program bit-for-bit at every rank count I tested.\n\n**What changed** (only `nbody/nbody.cpp` and `nbody/CMakeLists.txt`; the executable is still `nbody`)\n\n- **Decomposition:** each rank owns a contiguous block of bodies and keeps their velocities. Every rank holds the full position array, which is re-synced with `MPI_Allgatherv` after each step. Bodies that don't divide evenly across ranks are handled.\n- **Same arithmetic as the original:** each body's force sums over all `j` in the original order, so results don't depend on the rank count.\n- **Faster per rank:** the force loop is tiled over bodies so the compiler can vectorize it without reordering any sums. At one rank, 4096 bodies × 3 steps takes 94 ms versus 371 ms for the original.\n- **Output and validation:** only rank 0 prints. It gathers the final velocities, so `-r` and `-v` produce the same output as before. Every rank exits with the same status.\n- **MPI is unconditional:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and `MPI_Init` are always used. No new dependencies.\n- **CMake:** adds `-fno-math-errno` so `sqrt` vectorizes. It doesn't change any values.\n\n**Verification**\n\n- I compared the `-r`/`-v` output against a serial build of the original source across 8 body counts (1 to 1024, including counts not divisible by the rank count and zero steps) and rank counts 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 8. All 48 cases match exactly, including the hash.\n- `-h` and unknown options behave as before.\n- Timing on one node, 4096 bodies × 3 steps: 94 ms at 1 rank, 47 ms at 2, 39 ms at 4, 12 ms at 8.\n\n**Decisions to review**\n\n- **One line is GCC-specific.** GCC fuses the velocity update into an FMA, which changes the last bits compared with the original. I kept that one function unfused with `__attribute__((optimize(\"fp-contract=off\")))`. The other fused operations are unchanged. Clang ignores this attribute, so results there could differ from the GCC-built reference.\n- **Communication isn't overlapped with compute.** Overlapping would mean summing blocks in a different order, which would break bit-exactness. The per-step cost is O(N) against O(N²/P) compute, so this should scale well for large N.\n- **Multi-node runs are untested.** I only ran on one machine with Open MPI, up to 8 ranks.\n- **Pre-existing `-march=native`** still means binaries must be built on the node architecture they run on.\n\nThe repo isn't a git repository, so I haven't committed anything."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1734,"cache_read_input_tokens":89901,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1734},"output_tokens":7,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"3aba1c3b-b547-46b8-a4f2-496a9e18ae73","uuid":"4ba8abcd-c255-4041-927e-19528cb10b6c","timestamp":"2026-10-13T01:34:12.348Z","request_id":"req_011CfyNmGsFFqmRf64kQijCq"}
